texts.title_text: Waymo's custom chip is the key to its robotaxi ambitions, delivering unmatched efficiency and performance
texts.slide_1_text: Waymo announces custom silicon chip designed to handle massive data influx before reaching self-driving system core, with 1,000+ TOPS performance
texts.slide_2_text: The 5nm ASIC chip handles massive data influx, delivering over 1,000 TOPS of computing performance
texts.slide_3_text: Waymo's system can react fast and safely in cities with dense traffic and varying weather conditions, thanks to its custom chip
texts.slide_4_text: Waymo partners with AMD, Micron, Nvidia, Samsung, Sandisk, Socionext, and TSMC to develop its custom chip's capabilities
